newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 -USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog marketings:
Friday estimate: 105,000 Wk ago: 85,000 Yr ago: 100,000
Saturday estimate: 25,000 Wk ago: 24,000 Yr ago: 18,000
Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs.Barrows and gilts $1.00 per cwt lower than the midsession Thursday. Trade and offerings moderate for light demand.
Sows: 450 dn steady to 1.00 higher, 450 up mostly steady to $2.00 lower.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts $1.00-$1.50 higher. Sows steady to $2.00 higher. Receipts this week 544,000 last week 515,000, last year 554,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending Feb 22, 1997 252.3 lbs compared to 252.8 lbs previous week 248.4 lbs last year.
